decision_rule.threshold: label source_plus_transport_smoke_persistence when score >= 9, smoke_family_hits >= 4, and transport_source_ratio >= 1

key_values.event_name: August 2004 fire and smoke in Angola

criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON fields with numeric values, pass/fail flags, and the final computed label.
criteria.name: requested_json_schema
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the six requested top-level keys, 1 point for preserving the nested numeric fields, and 1 point for using the computed label field without extra keys.

criteria.description: Correctly reports event-window duration, article-title-plus-body fire/source counts, transport/source ratio, smoke-family text hits, and zero AOD/PM term hits.
criteria.name: source_and_smoke_counts
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for window_days = 1, 1 point for fire_hits = 2 with source_flags = 3, 1 point for transport_flags = 3 with transport_source_ratio = 1.0, and 1 point for smoke_family_hits = 4 with aod_pm_hits = 0.

criteria.description: Computes local precipitation, low-precipitation-day count, regional mean precipitation, GPM max/mean ratio, wind speed, and the dry, weak-wind, stagnation, and no-broad-precip-clearing flags.
criteria.name: clearing_and_stagnation_tests
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point each for local_precip_mm = 1.04, low_precip_days_le2mm = 5, regional_mean_mm = 5.34 with regional_max_mean_ratio = 15.24, era5_wind_ms = 0.74 with local_wind_kmh = 8.2, and pass_count = 4.

criteria.description: Computes the pre/event image mean absolute RGB change, normalized change, and smoke-like fraction delta within tolerance.
criteria.name: satellite_change_metrics
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for mean_abs_rgb_delta = 82.66, 1 point for normalized_rgb_delta = 0.324, and 1 point for smoke_delta_pct_points = 0.53.

criteria.description: Applies the persistence-score rule and threshold to reach the source-plus-transport persistence label.
criteria.name: score_and_threshold_decision
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the score formula, 1 point for persistence_score = 11, and 1 point for answer = source_plus_transport_smoke_persistence.

criteria.description: Briefly rejects source-only, rainfall-clearing, and point-wind-only interpretations using the computed values.
criteria.name: rejected_alternatives
criteria.partial_credit: Award the point when at least two rejected alternatives are tied to the numeric ledger; otherwise award 0.

criteria.description: Keeps the mechanism label concise and avoids health, loss, burn-scar, or response statements beyond the computed values.
criteria.name: concise_interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: Award the point when the final text stays within the requested data-driven diagnosis and does not add external impact or action statements.
